summary: Phase-5 Mobile Experience + PWA fully verified. PWA static assets (manifest.json/icon.svg/service-worker.js) all return correct MIME types and content. SW installs and `navigator.serviceWorker.controller` is non-null on second load. Mobile (390x800) responsive layout renders the mobile top bar (mobile-menu-btn 44x44), hides the desktop sidebar, opens a drawer containing nav-scan-qr. /app/scan renders start-btn, manual-scan-input, manual-scan-submit; camera permission failure is gracefully shown via scan-error. Pasting a full /app/assets/<uuid> URL into manual-scan-input correctly extracts the UUID via regex and navigates. AssetDetail quick-pass-btn debits ₹5 from the wallet (1602→1597) and toasts 'Quick Pass logged · −₹5. Balance ₹1597'. Install prompt banner is wired to a dispatched beforeinstallprompt event; install-dismiss persists 'fos_install_dismissed' to localStorage. Desktop layout @1920x900 still shows the left sidebar with mobile-menu-btn hidden. Backend regression: 100/100 PASS unchanged.

phase5_task_matrix.9_desktop_1920: PASS — viewport=1920 → nav-dashboard visible in left sidebar; mobile-menu-btn hidden (offsetParent=null).

phase5_task_matrix.14_quick_pass_inspection: PASS — clicking quick-pass-btn after window.confirm posts /api/inspections with overall_result='pass'; wallet balance went 1602→1597 (-₹5 exact); toast text = 'Quick Pass logged · −₹5. Balance ₹1597'.
phase5_task_matrix.15_performance_initial_login: PASS — /manifest.json 956 bytes, /icon.svg 607 bytes, /service-worker.js 1.4 KB. No single >1MB blocking JS chunk reported by browser; manifest served with charset header.
phase5_task_matrix.16_backend_regression: PASS — 100/100 backend pytest suite (backend_test.py 34 + test_stabilization.py 18 + test_phase2.py 13 + test_phase3.py 21 + test_phase4.py 14) green in 41.4s.
phase5_task_matrix.17_desktop_regression_smoke: PASS — Desktop @1920 dashboard sidebar nav loads; admin login → /app/dashboard works; AssetDetail still renders download-qr-btn and quick-pass-btn correctly.

issues: Need-Help FAB (need-help-btn) and 'Made with Emergent' platform badge still overlap at bottom-right on /app/* pages on both mobile and desktop. Carried over from iteration_5; cosmetic only.

test_authoring_notes: data-testid='nav-scan-qr' (and other nav-* testids) are duplicated in DOM at the md+ breakpoint when the mobile drawer is open — one in the desktop sidebar (hidden via Tailwind md:block) and one in the mobile drawer. At 390x800 only one exists (the mobile drawer one when open, desktop sidebar one when closed). At ≥768px, opening the drawer would not happen but the testid remains. Suggest scoping nav-* testids per-shell (e.g., desktop-nav-scan-qr / mobile-nav-scan-qr) OR use playwright `page.locator('[data-testid=mobile-drawer] [data-testid=nav-scan-qr]')` to disambiguate.

action_items: OPTIONAL (test-authoring nicety): scope nav-* testids per-shell (desktop-nav-* / mobile-nav-*) so Playwright `is_visible` works without DOM queries.
LOW (carried from iter_5): reposition NeedHelpFab to avoid the Emergent badge overlap (e.g., bottom-24 right-6 OR right-24).
critical_code_review_comments: service-worker.js cache strategy is correct: network-first for shell, never-cache for /api/, falls back to /index.html offline. cache name 'fos-shell-v2' bumped from v1 — old caches purged on activate.

manifest.json uses /icon.svg for all 3 size slots — works for Chrome PWA install but iOS expects PNG fallbacks (apple-touch-icon also points to .svg). Acceptable for an MVP; flag for future PNG generation.
InstallPrompt correctly preventDefaults the BIP event, stores ev for later prompt(), and gates re-show by a 7-day localStorage TTL. Clean teardown on unmount via removeEventListener.

QrScan.jsx uses Html5Qrcode lib correctly; prefers back/rear/environment camera; gracefully returns [] then surfaces 'No camera detected' on headless. No crash on permission denial — try/catch wraps scanner.start().

AssetDetail quick-pass-btn posts a 1-item checklist with overall_result='pass'; surfaces wallet_charge from response with a toast — UX quality is good (shows both amount debited and new balance). Clean error handling via toast.error on failure.
AppShell mobile drawer: sidebar component is reused (DRY) for both desktop and mobile via composition. The duplicated data-testid is a known artifact — see test_authoring_notes.
viewport meta in index.html includes viewport-fit=cover (notch handling) and maximum-scale=5 (allows pinch-zoom — accessibility plus).
All major buttons carry min-h-[44px] which meets Apple HIG / WCAG touch-target guidance.
Backend phase5 surface is unchanged — no new endpoints, no new dependencies; regression is clean.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase-5 is purely frontend/PWA — backend untouched. PWA assets live in /app/frontend/public/{manifest.json,icon.svg,service-worker.js,index.html}. Mobile UX wired in /app/frontend/src/components/AppShell.jsx (mobile-menu-btn + mobile-drawer + InstallPrompt + Scan QR nav). QR scan page at /app/frontend/src/pages/QrScan.jsx uses html5-qrcode. quick-pass-btn at /app/frontend/src/pages/AssetDetail.jsx lines 36–50. data-testid='nav-*' is duplicated when both desktop sidebar and mobile drawer are mounted — always use a parent-scoped locator: `[data-testid=mobile-drawer] [data-testid=nav-scan-qr]`. Tests confirmed: SW controller=true on 2nd load, install prompt dispatch+dismiss works and writes fos_install_dismissed, manual-scan-input regex correctly extracts UUID from a full URL, quick-pass debits ₹5 + toasts. NeedHelpFab vs Emergent badge overlap is still cosmetic (no functional impact).
mocked_apis_note: Resend email delivery remains MOCKED (RESEND_API_KEY empty). QR camera feed in headless Chromium has no real camera (lib returns [] cameras → graceful 'No camera detected' error). Both are environmental, not code defects.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs. The initial test run reported false-negative 'mobile-menu-btn invisible' because Playwright's is_visible() picked the duplicated desktop-sidebar copy of nav-* testids and that copy is hidden < md. A focused JS-evaluate test confirmed the actual mobile chrome IS visible at 390px (mmVisible:true, height:44, width:44). All 17 Phase-5 task assertions PASS in the focused re-run.
